title: Central Japan Railway Company Guide 2015
version: 2015 operator guide hosted by the Embassy of Japan in Australia
lineage: Original publisher's text inspected. Saved notes paraphrase the identified passages.

passages.locator: pp. 8–9, Shinkansen rolling stock succession and Series N700 and N700A
passages.note: The operator identifies the Series 700 as the basis of the N700, records the N700's July 2007 introduction and says that the 700 evolved from the second generation that began with the Series 300. It also dates the N700A debut to February 2013.
